toolsets.description: UnrealMCP whole-Blueprint authoring: export a Blueprint or Animation Blueprint as a JSON graph spec and apply a batch of edits (variables, components, functions, nodes, pins, links, AnimGraph state machines) atomically in one undo step, compiled, with structured errors and dry_run.
toolsets.name: UnrealMCP.Blueprint

tools.description:
Read a Blueprint as a JSON spec: parent class, compile status, variables (type, value),
        components (class, parent), and every graph's nodes with kind-specific fields, position,
        pins (name, dir, type, default) and links ("<node id>.<pin>"). Node ids are stable GUIDs
        usable in bp_apply connect/set_pins/remove_node. graphs: limit to e.g. ["EventGraph"].
        Works for Actor, Character, GameMode, AIController, widget and BT-task Blueprints.
tools.name: bp_export
bp_apply

tools.description:
Read an Animation Blueprint: skeleton, preview mesh, variables, status, the event graph,
        anim_graph nodes (kind sequence_player/blendspace_player/state_machine/slot/output, asset, slot,
        inputs = what feeds each pin), output_chain (what reaches Output Pose, e.g.
        ["slot", "state_machine:Locomotion"]) and state_machines: name, entry state, states (name,
        assets played, pose_wired, nodes) and transitions (from, to, blend, priority, automatic,
        reads = variables the rule reads, calls = functions it calls, rule_wired, rule_nodes).
        Node ids work in animbp_apply connect/set_pins/remove_node.
tools.name: animbp_export

tools.description:
Create (pass skeleton: a Skeleton or SkeletalMesh path) or edit an Animation Blueprint in ONE undoable
        step, then compile. Every bp_apply op works (add_variable, add_node, connect, set_pins, set_defaults, ...;
        the event graph is "EventGraph"), plus AnimGraph ops:
          {"op":"add_state_machine","id":"loco","name":"Locomotion"}            (graph: AnimGraph by default)
          {"op":"add_state","id":"idle","machine":"loco","name":"Idle","sequence":".../MM_Idle","loop":true}
          {"op":"add_state","id":"move","machine":"loco","name":"Move","blendspace":".../BS_Move",
           "inputs":{"X":"Speed"}}                       first state (or "entry":true) is the entry state
          {"op":"add_transition","id":"idle_move","from":"idle","to":"move","blend":0.2,
           "rule":{"var":"Speed","cmp":">","value":10}}
              rules: {"var":"IsInAir"} (bool) | {"var":"IsInAir","not":true} | {"var":"Speed","cmp":"<=","value":5}
                     | {"all":[...]} | {"any":[...]};  "automatic":true = leave when the state's animation ends
              hand-built rules: add_node with "graph":"idle_move", connect to "idle_move_result.bCanEnterTransition"
          {"op":"add_node","id":"slot","kind":"slot","slot":"DefaultSlot"}       (montages play through it)
          {"op":"add_node","id":"p","kind":"sequence_player"|"blendspace_player","graph":"<state id>",...}
          {"op":"connect","from":"loco.Pose","to":"slot.Source"},
          {"op":"connect","from":"slot.Pose","to":"output.Result"}
              "output" is the Output Pose node; "<state id>_result" a state's result ("Result" pin);
              states/machines can also be referenced by name ("Idle" or "Locomotion/Idle")
          {"op":"set_entry","state":"idle"}  {"op":"set_properties","node":"idle_move","properties":{"PriorityOrder":1}}
        Event graph (owner pawn -> variables), e.g.:
          {"op":"add_variable","name":"Speed","type":"float"}, {"op":"add_variable","name":"IsInAir","type":"bool"},
          {"op":"add_node","id":"upd","kind":"event","event":"BlueprintUpdateAnimation"},
          {"op":"add_node","id":"pawn","kind":"call_function","function":"TryGetPawnOwner"},
          {"op":"add_node","id":"vel","kind":"call_function","function":"GetVelocity","class":"Actor"},
          {"op":"add_node","id":"len","kind":"call_function","function":"VSize","class":"KismetMathLibrary"},
          {"op":"add_node","id":"setspeed","kind":"set_var","variable":"Speed"}, connect upd.then->setspeed.exec,
          pawn.ReturnValue->vel.self, vel.ReturnValue->len.A, len.ReturnValue->setspeed.Speed; IsInAir: cast to
          Character, GetCharacterMovement, IsFalling (class CharacterMovementComponent) -> set_var IsInAir.
        Returns success, failed ops, ids (alias -> node id), compile status/errors; atomic rollback as bp_apply.
tools.name: animbp_apply

toolsets.description: UnrealMCP UMG authoring: export and apply whole widget trees with canvas anchors and slots in one call.
toolsets.name: UnrealMCP.UI

tools.description:
Read a Widget Blueprint's tree: each widget's name, class, is_variable, text/percent,
        slot (canvas anchors/position/size/alignment, or box padding/alignment) and children.
tools.name: widget_export

tools.description:
Create (create=true) or edit a Widget Blueprint's tree in one undoable step.
          {"op":"add","name":"Root","class":"CanvasPanel"}                    (first add = root)
          {"op":"add","name":"HealthBar","class":"ProgressBar","parent":"Root","is_variable":true,
           "percent":1.0,"fill_color":[0.1,0.9,0.2,1],
           "slot":{"anchors":"top_left","position":[40,40],"size":[400,28],"alignment":[0,0]}}
          {"op":"add","name":"ScoreText","class":"TextBlock","text":"Score: 0","font_size":32,
           "color":[1,1,1,1],"justification":"right","is_variable":true,
           "slot":{"anchors":"top_right","position":[-40,40],"alignment":[1,0],"auto_size":true}}
          {"op":"add","name":"Menu","class":"VerticalBox","parent":"Root","slot":{"anchors":"center",...}}
          {"op":"add","name":"Title","class":"TextBlock","parent":"Menu","text":"Paused",
           "slot":{"Padding":[0,0,0,20],"HorizontalAlignment":"HAlign_Center"}}
          {"op":"set","name":"ScoreText","text":"Score: 10"}   {"op":"remove","name":"Menu"}
        anchors presets: top_left top_center top_right center_left center center_right bottom_left
        bottom_center bottom_right fill top_fill bottom_fill left_fill right_fill, or [minX,minY,maxX,maxY].
        "properties" sets any other widget property by reflection; non-canvas slot keys are slot
        properties (Padding, HorizontalAlignment, VerticalAlignment, Size).
        is_variable widgets become Blueprint variables (get_var in bp_apply, e.g. to SetPercent).
        Show it in game with bp_apply on a pawn/controller: K2Node_CreateWidget -> AddToViewport.
tools.name: widget_apply

toolsets.description: UnrealMCP AI authoring: Blackboard keys plus a whole Behavior Tree from one nested spec, and export.
toolsets.name: UnrealMCP.AI

tools.description:
Read a Behavior Tree (or a Blackboard asset): blackboard keys (name, type, base_class)
        and the node tree (type, name, properties incl. blackboard key names, decorators,
        services, children).
tools.name: bt_export

tools.description:
Create/update a Blackboard and build a Behavior Tree in one call. The whole tree is
        validated first; on any error nothing changes and errors lists every problem.

        keys (upserted): [{"name":"PatrolLocation","type":"vector"},
                          {"name":"Target","type":"object","base_class":"Actor"},
                          {"name":"HasLineOfSight","type":"bool"}]
            types: vector rotator bool int float name string object class enum
        root (replaces the tree; composites: Selector, Sequence, SimpleParallel):
          {"type":"Selector","children":[
             {"type":"Sequence","name":"Chase",
              "decorators":[{"type":"Blackboard","properties":{"BlackboardKey":"Target"}}],
              "children":[{"type":"MoveTo","properties":{"BlackboardKey":"Target","AcceptableRadius":80}}]},
             {"type":"Sequence","name":"Patrol","children":[
                {"type":"/Game/AI/BTT_PickPatrolPoint.BTT_PickPatrolPoint_C"},
                {"type":"MoveTo","properties":{"BlackboardKey":"PatrolLocation"}},
                {"type":"Wait","properties":{"WaitTime":2.0}}]}]}
        Node types accept short names (MoveTo, Wait, RotateToFaceBBEntry, RunBehavior, Blackboard,
        Cooldown, Loop, TimeLimit, DefaultFocus, ...), full class names, or Blueprint task classes.
        Blackboard key properties take the key name. Run it from an AIController Blueprint:
        bp_apply event BeginPlay -> call_function RunBehaviorTree (BTAsset pin = this tree).
tools.name: bt_build

toolsets.description: UnrealMCP level tools: compact level brief, actor inspection, level structure, and scene_compose (batched spawn/modify/delete with grid/circle/line patterns in ONE undo step).
toolsets.name: UnrealMCP.Scene

tools.description:
Compact overview of the current level: actor count, top classes and folders, spatial
        bounds, lights and cameras. Use first to orient in an unfamiliar level.
tools.name: scene_brief

tools.description:
One actor in depth: transform, tags, folder, bounds, components (meshes, materials,
        light intensity) and any requested editor properties (e.g. ["mobility",
        "static_mesh_component.cast_shadow"]). For raw reflection use object_describe.
tools.name: actor_inspect

tools.description:
Level structure: persistent world, loaded and streaming sublevels, World Partition
        flag, key world settings (kill Z, gravity, default game mode).
tools.name: level_inspect
scene_compose

toolsets.description: UnrealMCP asset search and dependency/referencer graphs.
toolsets.name: UnrealMCP.Assets

tools.description:
Search the Content Browser. query: case-insensitive substring of the asset name.
        class_name: exact asset class, e.g. StaticMesh, Material, MaterialInstanceConstant,
        Texture2D, Blueprint, NiagaraSystem, SoundWave, World. Returns full object paths
        (/Game/Dir/Asset.Asset) usable by every other tool. Engine content: path="/Engine".
tools.name: search_assets
asset_references

toolsets.description: UnrealMCP editor control: project context, safe level switching, console commands, Output Log tail with a cursor.
toolsets.name: UnrealMCP.Editor

tools.description:
Engine version, project name/dir, current level, enabled plugins, maps,
        and the path of the generated Python API stub (for unreal_api_build_index).
tools.name: project_context

tools.description:
Switch the editor to another map safely (use this instead of LevelEditorSubsystem.load_level /
        new_level in execute_python).

        path: "/Game/Maps/Arena". create=true makes the map with new_level and saves it when it
        does not exist yet. The current level must be saved first: save_current=true saves every
        dirty package (no prompts), discard_changes=true drops the edits.
        Before switching it drops Python references and collects garbage, and if the target's
        world is already in memory as a standalone copy (made by duplicate_asset, load_asset or an
        earlier new_level) it unloads that copy first: loading over it fatals the editor with
        "World Memory Leaks". When the current map streams the target in as a sub-level (a title or
        wrapper map), it first switches to a blank map so the streaming level unloads, collects
        garbage and then loads the target (left_world names the map it left).
        Returns current_level, created, unloaded_stale_copy.
tools.name: level_open

tools.description:
Run an editor console command (e.g. "stat unit", "r.ScreenPercentage 50",
        "obj list class=StaticMesh") and return its captured output.
tools.name: console_command

tools.description:
Tail the editor Output Log (kept in a ring buffer by the plugin).

        min_verbosity: Error, Warning, Display or Log. filter: case-insensitive substring.
        since_seq: only entries after this sequence number. Pass back `last_seq` from a
        previous call to see only what happened since (e.g. after a compile or PIE run).
tools.name: editor_log

toolsets.description: UnrealMCP reflection: describe any UObject/UClass, get/set any UPROPERTY (undoable), call any UFUNCTION.
toolsets.name: UnrealMCP.Reflection

tools.description:
Describe a UObject or UClass: properties (name, type, flags) and functions (signatures).

        path: object path, e.g. "/Game/BP_Player.BP_Player_C", an actor label in the current
              level (e.g. "PointLight_1"), or "/Script/Engine.Default__Character".
        class_name: alternatively a class, e.g. "StaticMeshActor" or "/Script/Engine.Character".
        include_values: also return current property values (objects only).
        filter: case-insensitive substring to narrow property/function names.
tools.name: object_describe

tools.description:
Read any property of a UObject or actor. Supports dotted struct/sub-object paths,
        e.g. property="RootComponent.RelativeLocation" or "LightComponent.Intensity".
tools.name: property_get

tools.description:
Write any property of a UObject or actor (undoable). Value is JSON matching the
        property type: numbers, strings, {"X":..,"Y":..,"Z":..} for vectors, object paths for
        object references, arrays for TArray. Returns old and new values.
tools.name: property_set

tools.description:
Call any UFUNCTION on an object (BlueprintCallable, CallInEditor, or native).

        args maps parameter names to JSON values. Returns the return value and out-params.
        For static library functions use the class default object, e.g.
        path="/Script/Engine.Default__KismetSystemLibrary".
tools.name: function_call

toolsets.description: UnrealMCP runtime: inject real key / Enhanced Input action presses into a running PIE session and measure frame, game, render, RHI and GPU times.
toolsets.name: UnrealMCP.Play

tools.description:
Inject input into a RUNNING PIE session (start it with editor_action pie_start), outside
        pie_test. key: FKey name (SpaceBar, W, LeftMouseButton, MouseX, Gamepad_LeftX, ...) or action:
        InputAction asset path (Enhanced Input, injected every frame). mode: press (tap, default
        0.1 s), hold (down for duration_s, default 1 s), axis (value every frame; number or [x, y]),
        release_all. Returns immediately; the input runs on the editor for duration_s.
tools.name: pie_input

tools.description:
Measure the next `frames` editor frames (PIE or not): average / p95 / p99 frame time,
        fps, and game-thread, render-thread, RHI-thread and GPU ms. For a gameplay benchmark run it
        inside pie_test steps ({"frame_stats": 300}) so it measures the game, not the idle editor.
tools.name: frame_stats
